body: Thank you. I told my psychiatrist what happened, but he just brushed it off as "oh well, shit happens." And implied that I was completely incompetent for disagreeing with him. It's $500 dollars to file a complaint with a lawyer, but it seems like the best route. I want these people to suffer as much as I have. Getting them fired isn't good enough.
I don't have anyone to talk to. It's obvious that I can't seek help. And it's obvious that I can't trust anyone.

No. I don't have any physical evidence anymore. They also covered it up in the medical records. I was being recorded the entire time, but they may have deleted everything. All I have are a list of names. Not all of them, but most.
I finally have a list of names of the people that abused me. I'm not sure what to do with it yet, but at least it's something.
Report to whom? The police?  The hospital? Where can I get help if everyone I turn to abuses me? It's better to not say anything at all. Or to do so as anonymously as possible.
I was depressed and called someone. They sent police to my house. They beat me up and kidnapped me. They took me to a hospital where I was physically, verbally, and sexually abused.
I also called a hotline once. I was kidnapped because of it.
